caption: An electric lawnmower reaches the end of its cord and the plug pulls out of the socket, and the mower stops.

sa.check: An electric lawnmower on a lawn with a cord running from it to a socket.
The plug pulls out of the socket.
The cord is drawn straight and taut before the plug comes out.
The order is mowing, cord taut, plug out, mower stops.

pc.expect: The mower stops when the plug leaves the socket: its travel ends and any stream of cut grass from the chute ceases.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the mower carries on mowing to the end of the clip; or the mower halts and its grass stream stops before the cord has gone taut; or grass keeps flying from the chute with the plug lying loose.

pc.expect: Once the plug is out the mower stays stopped; it does not start again with the plug lying loose, and the cut strip behind it stays cut.
pc.fail: The mower starts up again with the plug out; or grass discharge resumes with the plug on the ground; or the plug jumps back into the socket by itself; or the cut strip behind the mower returns to uncut.

pc.expect: The cord is drawn straight and taut before the plug comes out; once free it goes slack and drops to the grass.
pc.fail: The plug comes out while the cord hangs slack; or the cord stays stretched straight in the air after the plug is free; or the cord stretches like elastic; or the plug flies upward and stays aloft.

pc.expect: The mower stays on the grass on its wheels; if it moves after the plug comes out it only coasts on in the direction it was going.
pc.fail: The mower reverses direction on its own as the plug comes out; or lifts off the grass; or slides sideways across the lawn.

pc.expect: One mower, one cord, one plug, one socket; the plug leaves the socket whole and the mower passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The plug vanishes or a second plug appears; or the cord splits or detaches from the mower; or the mower passes through a fence or tree; or the mower changes shape.

pc.expect: The mower's colour, the cord's colour and the socket or reel stay the same.
pc.fail: The mower changes colour; or the cord changes colour; or the socket or reel changes design.

note: The motor and blades are hidden under the deck: 'the mower stops' is read from the mower's travel, the grass stream from the chute and any visible blade blur; sound is not judged. Who or what pushes the mower is not judged.
